projects.title: Interpretable and Controllable Neural Shape Parameterizations
projects.summary: Develop neural representations that parameterize 2D and 3D shapes in a way that is interpretable and controllable, building on approaches such as DeepGeo that combine neural networks with mesh-based deformation. The aim is to make shape parameters predictable when they are changed.

projects.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Flight Dynamics
projects.summary: Learn how an aircraft responds to control inputs by observing flight data with self-supervised methods such as Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), without manually labeled data.

projects.title: Structured 3D Shape Optimization with Part-Based Implicit Neural Representations
projects.summary: Use part-based implicit neural representations, with an auto-decoder that decodes latent vectors and poses into shape parts, to generate, edit and optimize 3D shapes for engineering design.

projects.title: Recovering Thin Structures in 3D Foundation Models
projects.summary: Improve the reconstruction of thin structures by transformer-based 3D foundation models, which perform poorly on such structures because of coarse patchification.

projects.title: Applied Deep Learning for Computer Aided Engineering
projects.summary: Apply deep learning to automate computer aided engineering (CAE) processes in order to reduce the time and human resources needed and lower R&D costs for industry.

projects.title: Real-Time 3D Tracking and Anomaly Detection for Maritime Kite Systems
projects.summary: Build a 360° vision-based system for real-time 3D tracking and anomaly detection of kites for an automated maritime kite wing system developed by Aether Swiss Kite, extending a previous semester project on 2D detection and trajectory mapping.

projects.title: Efficient Diffusion Models via Quantization and Compression
projects.summary: Explore and systematically evaluate quantization and compression methods for diffusion models, such as Stable Diffusion, to reduce their memory and computational cost for deployment on resource-constrained devices.

projects.title: 3D Surface reconstruction using 3D Gaussians and SDF
projects.summary: Investigate 3D surface reconstruction by combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with signed distance functions (SDF), building on methods such as SuGaR that either reconstruct surfaces from Gaussians directly or train a neural SDF alongside them.

projects.title: Computer Vision for Waste Management (CVLab x Wasteflow)
projects.summary: Computer vision project for waste management, carried out by CVLAB in collaboration with Wasteflow.

projects.title: Interpretable and Controllable Neural Shape Parameterizations
projects.summary: The project aims to build on DeepGeo to make neural shape parameterizations more interpretable, controllable, and efficient to optimize. Research questions include automatically finding parameter directions for geometric properties such as airfoil thickness, camber, or wing twist, and building compact, adaptive parameter spaces that improve optimization convergence.

projects.title: Open-Source Work on Dynamic High-level Synthesis Compiler Targeting FPGAs
projects.summary: Work on Dynamatic, an open-source dynamic high-level synthesis compiler based on MLIR that generates RTL for FPGAs from C/C++. Students can write compiler passes across the progressive lowering pipeline or contribute to debugging, visualisation, or benchmarking tools.

projects.title: Accelerate FPGA Implementation Time
projects.summary: Reduce the long bitstream generation time of FPGA implementation, aiming to cut it from several minutes to a few seconds for designs created with high-level synthesis from C/C++.

projects.title: Postquantum Cryptography Core Using High-Level Synthesis
projects.summary: Explore and improve the quality of results of post-quantum cryptography hardware cores generated with high-level synthesis from C/C++, compared with RTL-based designs.

projects.title: Low-Level Optimization of Dynamically Scheduled Circuits
projects.summary: Optimise dynamically scheduled circuits after the DHLS compiler output, working on RTL-to-FPGA implementation in Vivado during logic synthesis and place-and-route to address routing delays and congestion.

projects.title: Toward Coarse-Grained Field Programmable Gate Arrays
projects.summary: Study a coarser-grained version of FPGAs as a word-level reconfigurable computing fabric for data centre applications, with work on compiler optimisations, new architectural ideas, and physical implementation and modelling.

projects.title: Optimizing place and route for high frequency task parallel FPGA accelerators
projects.summary: Analyse and raise the operating frequency of HardCilk-generated FPGA circuits by inserting elastic buffers into their ready-valid interfaces and evaluating the results with Vivado place and route.

projects.title: SOC-graphical configurator as VS-code plug-in
projects.summary: Build a graphical SoC configurator as a VS Code plug-in, similar to Quartus QSYS, for the embedded systems used in CS-473 and CS-476, with export of SoC designs as TikZ pictures and PDF documentation.

projects.title: Hardware coherence on various wishbone bus-architectures
projects.summary: Investigate and implement software-configurable hardware coherence protocols (such as MSI and MESI) on wishbone shared, crossbar, and ring bus architectures, for a system based on the Hazard3 RISC-V CPU.

projects.title: A Digital Twin for collective decision making
projects.summary: Build on an existing pipeline that fits Digital Twins to zebrafish behaviour recorded in response to virtual conspecifics. The work starts with an auto-regressive generative model baseline, then uses interpretable approaches to understand decision making, ideally making predictions testable with real animals.

projects.title: Implementing and extending a biologically inspired computational model of spatial navigation in rodents
projects.summary: Implement a computational model of a virtual rat navigating environments, combining a taxon pathway (striatum-like stimulus-response learning) and a locale pathway (grid and place cells). The model is to be validated in reorientation and water-maze paradigms and then extended.

projects.title: Modeling perceptual rules of social interactions in single animal virtual reality
projects.summary: Investigate whether zebrafish attraction to virtual objects mimicking conspecific swim kinetics comes from hard-wired motion tuning or from coupling to the fish's own swim cycle. The approach uses computational modelling and machine learning fitted to video-tracked behaviour, with possible extension to neural signals.

projects.title: Quantum constraint satisfaction problems
projects.summary: Investigate quantum versions of constraint satisfaction problems such as K-SAT, where N quantum bits (spin-1/2) are subject to M constraints acting on them.

projects.title: Message passing for Quantum Models
projects.summary: Develop message passing techniques for simple quantum spin models on graphs.

projects.title: Universal prediction and alpha-mutual information
projects.summary: Experimentally study the performance of a newly devised class of predictors that estimate data sequences when information about the generating distribution is limited. The predictors are based on a generalized definition of mutual information.

projects.title: Scalable Distributed Cache Coherency
projects.summary: Designing scalable distributed cache coherence protocols that keep copies of shared data consistent across many machines while reducing the communication overhead that currently limits scalability.

projects.title: Accelerating Safe ML Systems
projects.summary: Using RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) to build machine learning systems that are both fast and secure, for example for distributed training of large models with secure collaborative training or robust ML.

projects.title: Distributed Resource Efficient Inference Engine
projects.summary: Projects addressing the challenges of Anyd, a distributed inference engine that runs generative AI inference across heterogeneous hardware from different vendors and networks, automatically managing resources and handling failures.

projects.title: Improving Coverage Reliability in Cortex-M Firmware Rehosting
projects.summary: Studies how the approximations of Cortex-M firmware rehosting systems (MMIO, interrupts, timers, DMA, initialization) affect the reliability of coverage reported by fuzzing. The project aims to build a framework that records coverage with execution context and to develop techniques that improve coverage-guided fuzzing of rehosted firmware.

projects.title: Ownership-Aware Bug Hunting in Rust Crates
projects.summary: Aims to build an ownership-aware bug detection mechanism for Rust crates that models ownership transitions caused by unsafe APIs, such as acquisition, transfer, duplication and destruction of resources. The goal is to detect bugs like double frees that arise when the compiler cannot track ownership, for example after bitwise copies of nested types.

projects.title: Dataset Acquisition for Low-Light Image Denoising
projects.summary: Capture a new dataset of noisy/clean image pairs and dark calibration frames at many exposure times, following the 2-Shots in the Dark protocol, to extend low-light noise modelling to a wider range of exposure times and sensor temperatures. The dataset will be preprocessed and published on Hugging Face with a dataset card.

projects.title: Does Personalization in Medical Collaborative Learning Learn Site Shortcuts?
projects.summary: Investigates whether standard personalized federated learning methods learn site-specific shortcuts (spurious correlations) when trained on medical data from multiple hospitals. The results are meant to inform a personalization method that keeps useful site-specific features while avoiding shortcuts.

projects.title: Whose bubble is it? Harvesting idle capacity in data-parallel, expert-parallel LLM serving
projects.summary: Characterises where GPU idle capacity arises in data-parallel, expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts LLM serving and under what conditions it can be harvested for parameter-efficient fine-tuning without violating service-level objectives through coupling between replicas.

projects.title: Noise or Lies? Distinguishing privacy protection from fairwashing in black-box audits
projects.summary: Studies when an external auditor, who only queries a platform's model as a black box, can distinguish an honest privacy-preserving platform (random, publicly known noise) from a manipulative platform performing fairwashing (targeted alteration of answers to hide discrimination).

projects.title: Privacy Vulnerability Transfer in Model Merging
projects.summary: Investigates how privacy vulnerabilities of constituent language models transfer into or are amplified within merged models obtained by model merging and task arithmetic, using membership inference and extraction attacks. Factors such as merging coefficients, number of merged models and task similarity are analysed.

projects.title: In-context learning as approximated Bayesian inference
projects.summary: Studies in-context learning (ICL) in transformers, challenging the hypothesis that they emulate gradient descent on least-squares objectives for tasks such as in-context linear regression. The project aims to show that for more complex statistical problems and architectures, transformers learn more sophisticated mechanisms.

projects.title: Controlling the timbre of wind instruments with active control
projects.summary: The project studies wind instruments modelled as axisymmetric hollow ducts with varying or constant cross-section, with the aim of controlling their timbre actively.

projects.title: Plasmacoustic headphones
projects.summary: The project builds on the corona discharge principle, which can produce a linear acoustic flow velocity source without a conventional membrane, to develop headphones.

projects.title: Development of a Graphical User Interface for Electroacoustic Absorbers
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a graphical user interface for electroacoustic absorbers, which rely on a closed-box loudspeaker whose membrane is given a prescribed acoustic impedance.

projects.title: Exploration and improvement of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture relying on a novel fusion strategy
projects.summary: The project explores and improves a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture that learns from several information channels (modalities) using a novel fusion strategy.

projects.title: Auditory distance perception
projects.summary: The project studies auditory distance perception, the ability to estimate how far away a sound source is, which supports spatial awareness and obstacle avoidance.

projects.title: 3D Sound Localization
projects.summary: The project addresses spatial hearing, the ability to localise sounds in three-dimensional space.

projects.title: Design of unprecedented sound sources: a dream come true with plasma loudspeakers?
projects.summary: The project investigates the design of novel sound sources based on a spherical geometry, which minimises scattering effects, using plasma loudspeakers.

projects.title: Optimization of corona discharge loudspeakers
projects.summary: The project aims to optimise corona discharge loudspeakers, which use the corona discharge principle to produce a linear acoustic flow velocity source without a conventional membrane.

projects.title: Modeling translation elongation dynamics through Variational AutoEncoders
projects.summary: The project uses Variational AutoEncoders to model translation elongation dynamics, building on ribosome profiling data that measures codon-specific ribosome dwell times.

projects.title: Enhancing Protein Design Through Advanced Graph Neural Networks
projects.summary: The project applies advanced graph neural networks to improve protein design, in the context of machine learning applications in biology.

projects.title: Development and characterization of an acoustic matched source
projects.summary: The project develops and characterises an acoustic matched source, drawing on nonlinear and time-varying systems to push the limits of conventional wave engineering materials.

projects.title: VENOVA : an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone
projects.summary: The project concerns an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone, building on a saxophone design developed by Yamaha engineers and on modelling and adjustment work.

projects.title: Controlling the timbre of wind instruments with active control
projects.summary: Develop a scaled prototype of an active wind instrument: a cylindrical hollow duct surrounded by a ring of active electroacoustic absorbers that change the acoustic impedance at the bell and so alter the instrument's timbre. The work includes COMSOL FEM simulations and control design, building the scale-model prototype, and acoustic assessment of the resonators and the whole instrument.

projects.title: Continuous-Domain Phase Retrieval in Dimension One
projects.summary: Study of phase retrieval for one-dimensional signals in a continuous-domain framework. The page lists it as an available master semester or bachelor project.

projects.title: Training Complex-Valued Denoisers for Phase Retrieval
projects.summary: Training denoisers that operate on complex-valued data and using them within phase retrieval algorithms. The page lists it as an available master semester project.

projects.title: Exploring Global Youth Art Through AI: A Semantic Analysis of the IMAJ Collection
projects.summary: Semantic analysis of the IMAJ / UNESCO youth art collection using artificial intelligence methods. The page lists it as an available master semester or bachelor project.

projects.title: High-Dimensional Gaussian Sampling: Cholesky versus Markov
projects.summary: Comparison of Cholesky-based and Markov-based approaches for sampling high-dimensional Gaussian distributions. The page lists it as an available master semester project or master thesis.

projects.title: Sampling from Learned Regularizers
projects.summary: Sampling methods based on learned regularizers for imaging inverse problems. The page lists it as a master semester project, currently marked reserved.

projects.title: Analysis of dendritic spine changes using deep-learning encoding in a latent space
projects.summary: Analysis of changes in dendritic spines using deep-learning encodings in a latent space. The page lists it as a master semester project or master thesis, currently marked reserved.

projects.title: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in the human Alzheimer's disease brain
projects.summary: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in human Alzheimer's disease brain tissue. The page lists it as a master semester project, currently marked reserved.

projects.title: Data curation and curriculum learning for pre-training, theory and practice
projects.summary: Study data curation and curriculum learning for LLM pre-training, combining theoretical analysis with practical experiments. Part of the Apertus-related LLM project block.

projects.title: Scaling to longer context windows through modifications of attention
projects.summary: Explore modifications of the attention mechanism to scale large language models to longer context windows.

projects.title: Efficiency engineering for LLM pretraining and specifically MoE architectures
projects.summary: Engineer efficiency improvements for LLM pre-training, with a focus on mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures.

projects.title: Tools-usage during pretraining & finetuning
projects.summary: Investigate integrating tool usage into LLM pre-training and fine-tuning.

projects.title: Safety and alignment during pretraining
projects.summary: Study how safety and alignment can be addressed during the pre-training of large language models.

projects.title: Novel architectures (including efficient long context or MoE related mechanisms)
projects.summary: Design and evaluate novel LLM architectures, including efficient long-context and mixture-of-experts mechanisms.

projects.title: Optimization dynamics for LLMs (Muon and AdEMAmix variants, and interactions with architecture)
projects.summary: Study optimization dynamics of LLM training, such as Muon and AdEMAmix variants, and how they interact with model architecture.

projects.title: LLM inference on old V100 GPUs
projects.summary: Make recent large open-weight MoE models run on the EPFL cluster of V100 GPUs, applying quantization and communication-efficient parallelism, and compare with newer GPUs.

projects.title: Communication-efficient gossip methods for replacing all-reduce in distributed LLM training
projects.summary: Replace all-reduce communication in distributed LLM pre-training with decentralized pairwise weight averaging, studying parallelism settings and communication compression.

projects.title: AI safety evaluations feeding back into Apertus Posttraining
projects.summary: Incorporate findings from recent red-teaming studies into the safety SFT and RL post-training recipes of the next Apertus generation, in collaboration with UN agencies such as UNICC.

projects.title: LLM Pretraining Data Curation
projects.summary: Advance pre-training data curation beyond baselines such as FineWeb-2 HQ using new signal extraction, semantic filtering and synthetic rephrasing, possibly studying data quality and the curse of multilinguality.

projects.title: Learning to sample on the fly for SGD / curriculum learning
projects.summary: Train an auxiliary network that assigns scores to training data points, and use these scores to select an improved set of training points for SGD.

projects.title: Improving factuality understanding for LLM training
projects.summary: Add a factuality tag or masking to each training document to help LLMs distinguish factual from non-factual content, aiming to reduce hallucinations; post-training techniques may also be explored.

projects.title: Build decentralized LLMs in the browser
projects.summary: Contribute to the DISCO team project building decentralized and federated training software, where clients such as phones or hospitals collaboratively train models while preserving data privacy; the practical work includes integrating the Burn framework in Rust.

projects.title: Contrastive latent alignment for multimodal reasoning
projects.summary: Explore a contrastive latent alignment process that enforces cross-modal and preference alignment within continuous latent reasoning paths, so that conflicting multimodal signals (e.g. visual hallucinations contradicting audio or text) do not corrupt the model's latent representations.

projects.title: Locating and ablating circuit-level private attribute sub-networks
projects.summary: Use activation-space dictionary learning to locate the circuits in a model that encode specific private attributes (PII), then ablate or orthogonalize those feature directions to remove PII while preserving zero-shot task performance, without retraining the model.

projects.title: Continuous latent flow matching for multimodal spatial reasoning
projects.summary: Develop a single-step continuous latent flow architecture that maps multimodal inputs (video, audio, language instructions) directly to latent action-reasoning representations for Vision-Language-Action models, aiming at accurate spatial problem-solving in one forward pass.

projects.title: Alignment-based conformance checking
projects.summary: Build a neuro-symbolic conformance checking framework that translates natural language regulatory articles (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) into linear temporal logic specifications and evaluates them on execution traces of multi-agent systems to detect and explain compliance failures.

projects.title: Visual stream parsing for compliance auditing
projects.summary: Design a real-time legal-visual concept engine that fuses vision-language or audio-visual-language streaming transformers with ontology graph mapping to track entities, infer sensitive personal attributes in video streams, and map scene semantics to legal frameworks such as the EU AI Act and GDPR.

projects.title: Voice anonymization with preservation of emotional prosody in multilingual settings
projects.summary: Design, implement and evaluate an AI-based acoustic transformation framework that hides speaker identity while preserving emotional prosody, semantic meaning and intelligibility, focused on French, Italian or German (including Swiss German), with evaluation on real-world data in collaboration with RTS.

projects.title: Linguistic and stylometric style transfer for long-form speech anonymization
projects.summary: Use sequence-to-sequence style-transfer models to translate or obfuscate individual speaking styles, syntax, dialectal markers and phrasing habits in long-form recordings, so that speakers cannot be re-identified, focused on French, Italian or German (including Swiss German), with evaluation with RTS.

projects.title: Privacy guarantees for speech anonymization
projects.summary: Build a framework that explicitly bounds and minimises mutual information across acoustic, emotional and linguistic speech characteristics, providing information-theoretic privacy guarantees against adaptive adversaries that use AI models trained on modified speech, with evaluation with RTS.

projects.title: Comparing Representational Hierarchies in Neural Networks
projects.summary: Investigates how layer selection and aggregation affect conclusions about representational similarity between neural networks. The goal is a principled way to compare models across their full representational hierarchies and to reassess evidence for representational convergence.

projects.title: What Do Language Models Need from 3D Encoders?
projects.summary: Studies what different pretrained 3D encoders (point clouds or Gaussian splats) contribute when connected to a language model, and explores how to make 3D representations more useful for LLMs in spatial reasoning. The question also extends to modeling the spatial organization of cells.

projects.title: Learning patient-level predictions from the spatial proteome
projects.summary: Develops a multiple instance learning approach that aggregates information across spatial scales, from single cells to niches and whole tissue, to predict patient-level outcomes such as cancer survival from multiplexed imaging data. The project also examines how instance choice and spatial scale affect predictions and whether model attention agrees with known pathology.

projects.title: Improving agents for single-cell genomics and biomedical discovery
projects.summary: Aims to improve the reasoning capabilities of LLM-based agents for single-cell biology tasks by training them with agentic reinforcement learning. The agents act as co-scientists that formulate hypotheses, design validation strategies and run computational workflows.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study neural circuit activity
projects.summary: Use computer vision and machine learning to extract neural activity patterns during behavior and predict links between behavioral and internal states.

projects.title: Build artificial neural networks to control a simulated fly
projects.summary: Develop biorealistic neural controllers for a physics-based neuromechanical simulation of the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster.

projects.title: Use robotic systems to automate biological experimentation
projects.summary: Develop automated vision-guided robotic systems that perform behavioral and/or neural experiments, making biological experimentation more accessible and repeatable.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study animal behavior
projects.summary: Apply computational and machine learning methods to quantify and segment fly behaviors, and link the behavioral sequences to simultaneously acquired neuroimaging data.

projects.title: Study the full graph (connectome) of the fly nervous system
projects.summary: Improve and analyze the fly connectome graph to answer questions about neural circuit motifs underlying complex motor behaviors.

projects.title: Behavioral studies in the laboratory
projects.summary: Hands-on laboratory work with flies to examine how neural activation or other perturbations modulate behavior, including designing experiments and analysing the resulting data.

projects.title: Build a robotic fly
projects.summary: Construct an insect-inspired robot and test bioinspired algorithms of limb control.

projects.title: Reusable Foundations for Probabilistic Proofs in Lean
projects.summary: Develop a reusable Lean library on top of Mathlib that provides foundations for probability (such as Markov chains, random walks and couplings), so that probabilists can formalize their results more easily. If time allows, the library will be used to formalize a paper on random graphs and branching processes.

projects.title: Tracking Novel Research Through the Publication Process: A Text-Embedding Approach
projects.summary: Study scientific conservatism in peer review by measuring the novelty of submitted manuscripts with text embedding models. The student reviews recent embedding models for semantic similarity and builds a framework that matches rejected papers to their eventual publications, using anonymized manuscript metadata and peer review outcomes from more than 2,000 Elsevier journals.

projects.title: Measuring Entrepreneurial and Industry Identity in the Asteroid-Mining Industry with NLP
projects.summary: Build an NLP pipeline to study how entrepreneurs and institutions describe themselves as the asteroid-mining industry takes shape. The student collects longitudinal text data by web scraping (including Internet Archive company websites, communications, interviews and media) and develops a model that separates general topics from individual and collective identity claims, validated against a manually annotated sample.

projects.title: Accelerating Geophysical Flow Simulation Using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Develop and train a fast machine learning-based emulator of geophysical flows such as landslides, rockfalls and snow avalanches, using data from material point simulations and remote sensing data. The page links the project to the Blatten site.

projects.title: Digital Twin Simulation of Rockfall Hazards
projects.summary: Build a computational framework based on the Discrete Element Method that predicts rockfall runout, taking into account boulder shape derived from drone imagery and the modeling of boulder fragmentation.

projects.title: Discovering Internal Material Properties from Surface Observations
projects.summary: Use physics-informed neural operators to infer internal material properties from data available on the boundary of a body, with applications in subsurface engineering and material testing.

projects.title: Segregation in granular flows
projects.summary: Study the mechanisms of segregation in granular flows and how particle shape affects this process, using the Discrete Element Method.

projects.title: Multiphysics Modeling of Fault Gouge
projects.summary: Study the contact mechanics and the thermal and fluid multiphysics of fault gouge, from both discrete and continuum modeling perspectives, to better understand earthquakes.

projects.title: Experimental Investigation of Architected Granular Materials
projects.summary: Experimentally explore architected granular materials, such as granular crystals and quasicrystals, for penetration applications.

projects.title: Phase-field Modeling of Fracture of Architected Structural Materials
projects.summary: Develop a micromechanics-informed phase-field computational model, potentially combined with deep learning, to capture fracture in architected materials and compare it against ongoing experiments.
